# Nhan Kiet To - Staff AI & Data Engineer Portfolio

> A high-performance, minimalist portfolio built on the Nuxt 4 "Future" stack, orchestrated by VitePlus and Mise. Designed for 2026-standard web architecture.

## Core Tech Stack
- **Framework:** Nuxt 4.4.2 (Native v4 mode)
- **Engine:** VitePlus (vp) v0.1.15
- **Manager:** Mise (Infrastructure-as-Code binary management)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v3.4.19 (Modernized Bridge)
- **Architecture:** Arsenal vs. Battlefield (Stateless Components + Stateful Pipelines)

## Project Arsenal (Stateless Libs)
- [/components/ParallaxHero.vue](components/ParallaxHero.vue): Cinematic 5s-reveal hero engine.
- [/components/ui/](components/ui/): Atomic Shadcn/Nuxt components with strict composition.
- [/libs/utils.ts](libs/utils.ts): Pure, side-effect-free functional logic.

## Project Battlefield (Stateful Pages)
- [/pages/index.vue](pages/index.vue): The central assembly point (Hero + Case Studies).
- [/pages/blog/](pages/blog/): High-density Nuxt Content v3 document flow.
- [/pages/resume.vue](pages/resume.vue): Optimized professional data visualization.

## Engineering Rules
- **Hybrid Versioning:** Tools/Core strictly pinned; Utilities relaxed (^). See [.agents/workflows/rule_versioning.md](.agents/workflows/rule_versioning.md).
- **Composition:** Arsenal (stateless) must be separated from Battlefields (stateful). See [.agents/workflows/architecture_composition.md](.agents/workflows/architecture_composition.md).

## Development Setup
- `vp install`: Syncs the entire hermetic environment.
- `vp run dev`: Launches the 2026-standard Nuxt 4 development server.
- `vp run build`: Generates the production-grade static bundle for GH Pages.
